cells=None
D=[]
with gzip.open('inputs/sample.swap.rna.q2.tsv.gz','rt') as f:

        parts=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')

    mx=max((r[j],i) for i,r in enumerate(D))
    print(c, 'sum', s, 'max', mx)
# correlations pearson
n=len(D)
def pear(a,b):
    ma=sum(a)/n; mb=sum(b)/n
    va=sum((x-ma)**2 for x in a); vb=sum((x-mb)**2 for x in b)
    cov=sum((a[i]-ma)*(b[i]-mb) for i in range(n))
    return cov/math.sqrt(va*vb)
cols=[[r[j] for r in D] for j in range(10)]
print('corr')
for j,c in enumerate(cells):
    vals=[]
    for k in range(10):
        vals.append(round(pear(cols[j],cols[k]),3))
    print(c, vals)

markers={}
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2,values_only=True):
 gene=row[0]; ann=row[7]
 if ann is None: continue
 # ann \"1 - Epidermis\"
 label=ann.split(' - ',1)[1].strip()
 ct=ctmap.get(label)
 if ct is None: continue
 # keep top 100 by avg_log2FC order per original cluster, but sorted within celltype
 if ct not in markers: markers[ct]=[]
 markers[ct].append((row[2],gene))
# for each cell type sort by logfc desc top100
for ct in markers:
 markers[ct]=[g for _,g in sorted(markers[ct], reverse=True)[:100]]
# load matrix

with gzip.open('inputs/sample.swap.rna.q2.tsv.gz','rt') as f:
 for i,line in enumerate(f):
  p=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
  if i==0: cells=p[1:]; continue
  genes.append(p[0]); D.append([float(x) for x in p[1:]])
idx={g:i for i,g in enumerate(genes)}
# for each column and each marker set, compute mean z? Use score = sum log1p(expr) or mean rank? Simpler mean expr and specificity.
print('celltype marker counts', {k:len(v) for k,v in markers.items()})
# score = mean of expression normalized by gene's max across columns (0-1 specificity)
# precompute max
maxes=[max(r[j] for r in D) for j in range(len(cells))]
for j,cell in enumerate(cells):
 scores=[]
 for ct,gs in markers.items():
  vals=[]
  for g in gs:
   ii=idx.get(g)
   if ii is not None: vals.append(D[ii][j])
  if vals:
   scores.append((ct, sum(vals)/len(vals), len(vals)))
 scores.sort(key=lambda x:-x[1])
 print('\\ncol',cell,'top marker-set scores:')
 for s in scores: print(s)
